metadata.article_title: Where amount is stated differently in figures and words.

article.title: Where amount is stated differently in figures and words.
article.content:
18Where amount is stated differently in figures and words.

Section 18  ·  Chapter II  ·  page 11 of the Act
If the amount undertaken or ordered to be paid is stated differently in figures and in words, the amount stated in words shall be the amount undertaken or ordered to be paid.
